Working on energy systems modeling and decarbonization research across national and regional scales in Latin America.

:::: {.now-cards}

::: {.now-card}
### Current Work

- Modeling land transport decarbonization under different EV charging strategies, looking at environmental and techno-economic impacts across the region.
- Building a national roadmap for green ammonia production in Colombia, covering technical, economic, and environmental dimensions.
- Developing hourly cooling load curves for the residential sector to better characterize energy demand.
:::

- Energy systems modeling (EnergyPLAN, OSeMOSYS)
- Renewable energy integration and power system planning
- Transport electrification and decarbonization
- Industrial decarbonization (steel, cement, hydrogen, ammonia)
- Energy modeling to support public policy
